segments.source: `dest`: A pointer to the destination vImage buffer structure. You’re responsible for filling out the [`height`](vimage_buffer/height.md), [`width`](vimage_buffer/width.md), and [`rowBytes`](vimage_buffer/rowbytes.md) fields of this structure, and for allocating a data buffer of the appropriate size.
